sourceSentences: If Decimating Smash was charged for at least 1 second, Sion instead slams his axe down, dealing physical damage to enemies hit, knocking them up and stunning them.
A flash of the axe and change in brightness of the indicator on the ground indicates when the 1 second time frame is reached.
The indicator is visible to the enemy only if they see Sion himself.
Recast: Sion flails his axe in the direction he targeted at the time of cast, dealing physical damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 50% for 0.25 seconds.
Soul Furnace can be recast after 3 seconds while the shield holds, and does so automatically at the end of the duration.
Both of Soul Furnace's casts can be activated during Sion's other abilities.
Sion bellows a shockwave in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit, slows them for 2.5 seconds and inflicts them with 25% armor reduction for 4 seconds.

If the target is a minion or non-epic monster, they are also stunned for 0.75 seconds and knocked back for up to 1350 units further, though not through terrain, applying Roar of the Slayer's effects to enemies they pass through as well.
Unlike the intial single-target projectile, a thrown minion or monster is not blocked by Wind Wall or similar effects.
Sion will stop upon colliding with an enemy champion or terrain during the charge, ending Unstoppable Onslaught with a slam. Crashing into terrain stuns Sion for 0.5 seconds.
Unstoppable Onslaught does not apply the knock up nor stun to enemies from slamming on collision with terrain.
Unstoppable Onslaught cannot charge through but can leap over player-generated terrain.
Recast: Sion leaps forward, causing him to stop charging and slam the ground beneath him as if Unstoppable Onslaught had reached the end of its duration.
Sion can only move and use his basic attacks and item actives, and empowers himself with the following effects
Upon death, the current cooldowns of Sion's summoner spells are increased to 4 seconds. Afterwards, he is still unable to use them until he respawns.
